title: Pentacles in tarot: Ace to Five meanings
description: The Ace to Five of Pentacles in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for opportunity, balance, teamwork, security and hardship, as prompts for reflection.

scenes.headline: Pentacles in tarot: Ace to Five meanings
scenes.caption: The Ace to Five of Pentacles trace the practical side of life from a first opportunity through balance, craft and security to a time of scarcity.
scenes.vo: The Ace to Five of Pentacles trace the practical side of life from a first opportunity through balance, craft and security to a time of scarcity.

scenes.headline: Ace of Pentacles
scenes.caption: Opportunity, a fresh start, groundedness. A hand emerges from a cloud offering a single pentacle above a garden.
scenes.vo: Ace of Pentacles. Opportunity, a fresh start, groundedness. A hand emerges from a cloud offering a single pentacle above a garden.

scenes.headline: Two of Pentacles
scenes.caption: Balance, juggling, adaptability. A figure juggles two pentacles linked by an infinity-shaped loop while ships ride waves behind.
